Group.title: Group
Group.description: Represents a group or flat within the NourishTrack application, enabling shared meal and expense tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the group entity.

groupName.description: The name of the group or flat.

invitationCode.description: Unique code used for users to join the group.

mealTypes.description: List of available meal types for logging.

isMealItemNameRequired.description: Whether the item name for a meal is mandatory.

isExpenseDescriptionRequired.description: Whether the description for an expense is mandatory.

isUtilityReceiptRequired.description: Whether a receipt upload is mandatory for utility expenses.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the NourishTrack application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

photoURL.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

groupId.description: Reference to Group that the user belongs to.

isAdmin.description: Indicates whether the user is an administrator of a group.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: Represents a member within a group, containing their email and role.

photoURL.description: URL of the member's profile picture.

role.description: The role of the member within the group (e.g., 'admin', 'member').

joinedAt.description: The timestamp when the member joined the group.

MealLog.title: MealLog
MealLog.description: Represents a meal log entry for a user.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Represents a shared expense incurred for the group. This includes both food purchases and utility bills.

groupId.description: The ID of the group this expense belongs to.

userId.description: The ID of the user who logged the expense.

userName.description: The display name of the user who logged the expense.

expenseItem.description: A structured description of the expense (e.g., 'Rice, Oil' or 'Electricity Bill').

amount.description: The total amount of the expense.

date.description: The date the expense was incurred.

receiptPhotoUrl.description: An optional URL for a photo of the receipt.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the expense was logged.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a chat message within a group.

FoodItem.title: FoodItem
FoodItem.description: Represents a master food item in the inventory, including its monthly required quantity.

Purchase.title: Purchase
Purchase.description: Represents a single purchase of a food item.

itemId.description: The ID of the FoodItem this purchase is for.

profilePictures/{userId}.write: allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId && request.auth.token.email_verified == true;

chatImages/{groupId}/{imageId}.read: allow read: if request.auth != null && request.auth.token.email_verified == true && exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/groups/$(groupId)/members/$(request.auth.uid))
chatImages/{groupId}/{imageId}.write: allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.token.email_verified == true && exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/groups/$(groupId)/members/$(request.auth.uid))

receipts/{groupId}/{receiptId}.read: allow read: if request.auth != null && request.auth.token.email_verified == true && exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/groups/$(groupId)/members/$(request.auth.uid))
receipts/{groupId}/{receiptId}.write: allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.token.email_verified == true && exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/groups/$(groupId)/members/$(request.auth.uid))

storage.reasoning: Storage rules are set to allow any authenticated member of a group to read and write images to folders scoped to their specific `groupId`. Profile pictures are public to read but can only be written by the owner of that profile. This prevents users from one group from accessing the images of another group and users from editing other users profile pictures. A check for request.auth.token.email_verified ensures only verified users can write.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. Users can only access their own document.
Stores group information. Readable by members, writable only by the group admin. Email verification required.
Stores basic info about group members. Readable by all members. Writable by admins or the member themselves. Email verification required.
Stores meal logs. Accessible only by members of the group. Users can only create/edit their own meals. Email verification required.
Stores all expense entries. Accessible only by members of the group. Users can only create/edit their own expenses. Email verification required.
Stores chat messages. Accessible only by members of the group. Users can only create their own messages. Email verification required.
Stores master food item list. Readable by all members, writable only by admins. Email verification required.
Stores individual purchase records. Accessible by all members. Users can only create/edit their own purchases. Email verification required.

firestore.reasoning: This structure enforces security by scoping all group-related data within a group's subcollections. The rule `exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/groups/$(groupId)/members/$(request.auth.uid))` is used consistently to verify that the requesting user is a member of the group they are trying to access. Adding `request.auth.token.email_verified == true` to the rules ensures that only users who have verified their email can access or modify data, enhancing security. This is a secure and scalable pattern that prevents unauthorized data access. Write access is also based on group membership, with more restrictive admin-only writes on the core group document. Firestore's default-deny policy ensures any path not explicitly granted access is automatically blocked.
